item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 19/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will bring very hot weather to southeastern China tomorrow, but there will also be a few showers over the region. The area of low pressure now over the central and southern parts of the South China Sea will intensify into a tropical cyclone gradually, and it will have more a higher chance to move towards the vicinity of Hainan Island and western Guangdong in the next couple of days. However, its movement and intensity are still quite uncertain. The associated squally showers and thunderstorms are expected to affect the coast of Guangdong early next week. It will be windy over the region. Besides, another area of low pressure over the western North Pacific will also develop into a tropical cyclone gradually and move in the general direction of the seas near Taiwan.
